skill_title: Compare prices across countries (Big Mac Index style)
notes: 20-item bank, Grade 12 only. CAPS mix: 10 L3 / 10 L4. Convert prices to common currency. Interpret purchasing-power differences. Pair with local wages.

stimulus.inline:
**Big Mac Index — illustrative**

| Country | Local price | Currency | Rate (per ZAR) |
|---|---|---|---|
| South Africa | R50 | ZAR | 1 |
| USA | 5,40 USD | USD | 1 USD = R18,50 |
| UK | 4,10 GBP | GBP | 1 GBP = R23,40 |
| Australia | 7,20 AUD | AUD | 1 AUD = R12,30 |

items.question: Which country has the cheapest Big Mac (in Rand-equivalent)?
workingSteps: R50 < R88,56 < R95,94 < R99,90 → SA is cheapest.

stimulus.inline: Implied exchange rate from Big Mac Index. If a Big Mac is 5,40 USD in USA and R50 in SA, the IMPLIED rate is R50 ÷ 5,40.

items.question: Calculate the IMPLIED rate (R per USD).

stimulus.inline: Implied R/USD ≈ R9,26; actual R18,50/USD.

items.question: Is the Rand UNDER- or OVER-valued vs the USD by Big Mac Index?
options: Under-valued — Rand weaker than implied; SA goods are cheap relative to USA.
items.expectedAnswer: Under-valued — Rand weaker than implied; SA goods are cheap relative to USA.
workingSteps: Actual rate (R18,50) > implied (R9,26): Rand buys less than the Big Mac index suggests it should. Rand under-valued.

Under-valued — Rand weaker than the product comparison suggests.

_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_CURRENCY_DIRECTION: Multiplies when division was needed (or vice versa) for FX.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_UNIT_PRICE_INVERSION: Divides the wrong way around for implied rate or hours-per-product.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_COMMISSION: Misapplies commission or leaves it out.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_RATE_COMPARE: Compares two prices without converting both to the same currency.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_FX_DIRECTION: Misinterprets a strengthen/weaken or over-/under-valued reading.
